blurb: Blue Diamond Boat Rentals offers boat rentals in Daytona Beach and surrounding areas, with most rentals including a chartered captain. They provide night charters featuring colorful LED lighting for a unique evening experience on the water. Reservations can be made online or by contacting them directly, with full refunds for weather cancellations.
